adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner. Given the name and typical permission logic, this likely should be `||` so that either admins or owners are allowed. As written, a team admin who is not also an owner will fail `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee)` and be incorrectly rejected with `FORBIDDEN`.
